title: Best Shampoo (2026)
summary: We're still testing and researching this guide. Picks will be added soon.
method: I cross‑referenced the NBC Select and Byrdie articles, selecting shampoos that appear in either list and ranking them by the number of endorsements and breadth of coverage. Products that address common issues—dry scalp, color protection, dandruff, and thinning hair—were prioritized.
assumptions: Prices are reported only when a source provides them; otherwise the price field is null. No external price data or brand claims were added.
